slack_add_reaction.rationale: Governed mutation: adds visible engagement to a workspace message under the bot identity; reversible but externally observable.

slack_get_channel_history.rationale: Pass-through (read): retrieves messages the credential is already authorized to read and does not mutate Slack state.

slack_get_thread_replies.rationale: Pass-through (read): retrieves replies the credential is already authorized to read and does not mutate Slack state.

slack_get_user_profile.rationale: Pass-through (read): retrieves one authorized workspace profile and does not mutate Slack state.

slack_get_users.rationale: Pass-through (read): lists authorized workspace profiles and does not mutate Slack state.

slack_list_channels.rationale: Pass-through (read): lists channels visible to the credential and does not mutate Slack state.

slack_post_message.rationale: Governed external communication: publishes text to a channel under the organization's bot identity and may notify many people.

slack_reply_to_thread.rationale: Governed external communication: publishes text in an existing thread under the organization's bot identity and may notify participants.
